request: 搞一下：基于浏览器内核，实际像独立软件运行；先交付 Mac Aide.app，复用现有页面和本地服务，独立窗口图标菜单，自动启动登录，验证语音权限与退出行为；追加：插件打开工作台统一进入新页面，保留原聊天/工作区
acceptance: Build and install an actual macOS Aide.app with an independent WKWebView window, icon, native menus and shortcuts
Reuse existing local startup/service and token bootstrap without showing secrets or restarting an already healthy installation
Constrain embedded navigation and media permissions to the verified local origin, with exact local certificate pinning and normal external TLS validation
Native upload/download and JavaScript dialogs work; default page/voice UI remains unchanged
Close hides/reopen restores the workbench; quit ends the desktop UI and preserves shared service/tasks; explicit stop-and-quit requires confirmation
Actual native app startup and visible UI verification, native permission/capability probes, focused regressions and clean artifacts
Plugin workbench launch actions open separate scoped pages/native tabs; existing sandbox/bridge and approval boundaries remain; actual Compare/ProfessionalProject pages render
scope: desktop.command and existing POSIX startup/build integration
installation-scoped generated app bundle and user Applications entry
task/architecture documentation; Mac implementation only, native Windows unchanged
existing plugin workbench host, safe page route and focused tests
local embedded web-asset rebuild through build.command and native runtime acceptance

requirements.summary: User accepted independent desktop-shell proposal. Current client is Mac; initial implementation uses WKWebView over the existing local Go/Docker service and unchanged web UI. No public release or backend rewrite.

design.summary: WKWebView desktop host with verified installation-scoped session bootstrap. Plugin workbench commands create same-origin scoped page routes; each page recreates the existing sandbox/MessagePort bridge. File rendering lifecycle remains separate. Generated native bundles use local Library/Caches to avoid iCloud FinderInfo signature damage.

implementation.summary: Native app and scoped local cache compile successfully. Canonical build/start integration and plugin workbench new-page routing implemented; native close/quit respects plugin dirty state. Local source integration/web-asset deployment is next.

verification.summary: Mac arm64 app compiled/installed; actual AppKit tabs, shared data store, close/reopen, native dialog and upload/download cancellation paths passed. User confirmed unlock. Focused Python 10+launcher35+fingerprint4 tests and plugin bridge21/page routing5 tests pass. New plugin page rendering after local source build remains. No live mic capture/paid model call or real file transfer claimed.

documentation.summary: README and existing launcher contract link the Mac app entry; architecture documents startup, scoped cache, plugin tabs, account/media limits and rollback.

rollback: Quit Aide.app and use the existing localhost Safari entry; backend data is shared. Existing running image was retained before source deployment. New public Release is not part of this request.
handoff: In progress: integrate source, build local embedded web assets, verify native plugin pages, finish scoped cleanup. Microphone TCC remains notDetermined; platform WebAuthn authenticator unavailable in this host; original password fallback preserved.
